messages:
maria: Quick heat-check before we flip the small-burst toggle for model-v5 in eu. Plan: 2% eu traffic -> 10% eu over 30m -> 20% if green. Anyone oncall/ops able to watch metrics? :eyes:

keon: @maria I can be oncall for the window 14:00-16:00. What's the exact flag and rollback thresholds?

maria: Flag is `flags.model_v5_rollout` scoped by region/audience. Using the rollout API (example):
```
POST /flags/toggle
{
  "flag": "model_v5_rollout",
  "percent": 2,
  "region": "eu",
  "note": "small-burst heatcheck"
}
```
Rollback conditions: p95 latency +30% OR 5xx rate >0.7% OR generation quality regression (quality metric drop >2 pts). We'll watch latency, 5xx, GPU queue depth, and quick eval set.

jin: Can we make the first 10m internal-only? Prefer internal subset (IDP/control users) before public.

maria: Good call. Plan tweak: 2% internal (10m) -> 2% public (10m) -> 10% public (30m) -> evaluate for 20%.

keon: I have `ffctl` to flip percent: `ffctl set model_v5_rollout --region eu --percent 2 --audience internal --meta \"heatcheck\"`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle at 2025-03-17T14:05Z by @maria. ID tgl_74321. :rocket:

ryan: Who makes the rollback call? Oncall or release lead?

maria: Release lead (keon) will own the final go/no-go. Oncall pages infra if infra errors spike. Escalation in runbook: /runbooks/model-rollouts (see section \"canary aborts\").

jin: I'll run prompt-set A/B evals and post diffs every 5m (perplexity, hallucination rate, rouge).

keon: I'll watch latency/cpu/gpu queue depth and error spikes. SLOs to watch: p95, 5xx rate, GPU queue depth. Auto-cut: sustained 5m above threshold triggers immediate flip to 0% by infra alert.

ryan: Note: avoid FR maintenance nodes. The ILL-queen cluster (eu-west-2) is in maintenance until 14:20 — target eu-west-1 only for the first 10m.

maria: Updated command for first step:
`ffctl set model_v5_rollout --region eu-west-1 --percent 2 --audience internal --note \"heatcheck\"`

jin: ack. I'll post numbers at 14:10/14:15/14:20.

keon: Also check token-cost delta; expect ~+4% token consumption due to longer outputs. Keep an eye on cost-per-token vs latency tradeoff.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Preflight checks passed — gating=ok, model-compatibility=ok.

maria: Thanks. Pushing scheduled toggle now. Ping me @keon if you want to abort. :thumbsup:

keon: Copy. I'll be ready to cut to 0% if thresholds breached.

maria: (14:12) heatcheck started; internal 2% in eu-west-1. I'll post live updates here.

jin: (14:17) quick evals posted: perplexity +0.3, hallucination rate stable, rouge diff within noise.

keon: (14:25) metrics look green. Preparing to switch audience to public 2% at 14:30.

maria: (14:30) switched to public 2%. Ramp to 10% scheduled for 14:40 if still green.

keon: (14:35) p95 at 1.05x baseline, 5xx=0.02%. No infra flags. Proceeding with ramp at 14:40.

maria: (14:41) ramped to 10% public. Monitoring.

jin: (14:46) evals still within thresholds. No quality regressions seen.

keon: (15:02) holding at 10% to observe usage patterns. If stable we'll propose 20% tomorrow.

maria: Great job team — keeping this thread for the post-mortem notes.
